drivers: Simple Latin-square distribution: each row/column contains the same three shape-fill combinations, so the missing cell is just the one absent from row 3 and column 3
Shape and fill are perfectly correlated, so only one attribute needs tracking; count and rotation are constant
Distractors differ on count (5 vs 4) and on shape/fill mismatches, requiring careful checking of all three features but no inference
Generous 75-second limit for a low working-memory-load item
